maria-cs: Heads-up 2 HelioCare intake: they need an inpatient discharge summarizer with strict PHI routing and an embeddings policy. Paste: 

HelioCare (customer):
> Requirements:
> - Any PHI-tagged request must stay in our Private VPC. No PHI to hosted endpoints.
> - Tokenizer should treat patient IDs and names as single tokens to avoid redaction splits.
> - Embeddings: PHI must be stripped before storage; non-PHI embeddings may go to hosted.
> - Safety/regression: run a 40k-token offline eval + a small A/B vs legacy outputs.
> - Canary with auto-fallback if p50 latency > 600ms or regression > 4%
> Pilot target: 3 weeks. Samples attached (1.5k notes).

andre-cs: i'll own kickoff and network ask. looping @rita-se + @sam-ml + @jessie-sec.

rita-se: routing approach: add a lightweight edge tagger that marks phi:true and forwards to Private control plane. needs their VPN/CIDR and hooks for callbacks.

sam-ml: tokenizer options: (1) modify tokenizer/vocab (preferred) then convert model weights; (2) preprocessing placeholder for IDs (faster). prefer (1) if timeline permits.

sam-ml: eval estimate: 2-day smoke (5k) then full 40k run ~5 business days including analysis. Need golden outputs and metrics (PII leakage, ROUGE/BERTScore).

jessie-sec: security checklist: KMS access for Private, disable KV persistence for PHI, audit export to their SIEM, PHI regex coverage tests.

maria-cs: action items:
- andre-cs: schedule kickoff + request VPN/CIDR + golden set (ETA EOD tomorrow)
- sam-ml: start tokenizer prototype with samples (ETA 3 business days)
- rita-se: open infra ticket for control-plane forwarding (ETA 1 business day)
- jessie-sec: PHI checklist + short questionnaire for HelioCare (ETA 2 business days)

onboard-bot: Created onboarding card REDW-5220 -> HelioCare PHI routing & tokenizer. Owner: andre-cs. Due: 1994200000.
